name: CtrlZ Guard
author: JesusLovesYou1013
description:
Stops Ctrl+Z from suspending programs in your terminal (Claude Code, editors, anything) — it sends undo (Ctrl+_) instead.
• Must be ENABLED to take effect: installs disabled unless you use --enable, or turn it on in Setup › Plugins › Enable Plugin.
• Changes nothing until enabled; while enabled it adds one marked block to each foot, alacritty, kitty and ghostty config you have.
• Disable or remove the plugin and those blocks are deleted, restoring your configs exactly.
• Skips terminals with no config and any config where you already bind Ctrl+Z.
• Applies to newly opened terminal windows; already-open windows keep the old behaviour.
• No UI or bar icon — it runs quietly in the background.
